maximum_depth_rule: The reviewed current source provides plan baselines and R9 targets, not reviewed annual actuals. Every record therefore remains partial with annual_actual explicitly unavailable.
reference_boundary: National values are retained only as official reference context. They are not Okinawa annual actuals and do not make a record comparable across prefectures.
non_goals: Do not promote a plan baseline to an annual actual.
Do not use national reference values as Okinawa current results.
Do not correct the single official source anomaly without a replacement source.
Do not calculate achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
